name: Self Examination
overview: Scripture calls believers to a thorough and prayerful self examination, recognizing the need to identify and confess iniquities and secret faults as David and Job exemplify in their pleas for God’s cleansing and mercy. This process involves communing with one’s own heart in holy awe and stillness, diligently searching the spirit, and seeking God’s discerning trial of the heart, all with a purpose of amendment and spiritual growth. Such self examination is necessary before approaching communion, underscoring its vital role in maintaining a sincere and repentant fellowship with God.
